metadata.title: FAQ | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Answers to common parent questions about Sanskriti Kindergarten programs, timings, meals, transport, and child progress updates.

hero.subtitle: Clear, practical answers for families getting to know Sanskriti Kindergarten.

image.alt: Children learning together in a bright kindergarten classroom

sidebar.description: Reach out for admissions, classroom guidance, schedules, or anything related to your child's learning journey.

faqs.q: What age groups do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept children aged 2 to 6 years. Our programs are tailored to each developmental stage: Toddlers (2-3), Pre-K (3-4), and Kindergarten (4-6).

faqs.q: What are the school hours and daycare options?
faqs.a: Our standard school hours are 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM for Pre-K and until 3:00 PM for Kindergarten. We also offer an extended daycare facility until 6:00 PM for working parents.
To ensure individual attention, we maintain a small ratio of 1:10. Each classroom has a lead teacher and a trained assistant, plus specialized support staff for activities.

faqs.q: What is your philosophy on education?
faqs.a: We follow a Reggio-inspired, play-based philosophy. We believe children are capable, resilient, and full of potential, learning best through creative expression and discovery.
Yes, we have an in-house kitchen that prepares fresh, nutritious vegetarian meals daily. We focus on a balanced diet and also accommodate specific allergies or dietary needs.

faqs.q: How do you handle safety and security?
faqs.a: Your child's safety is our priority. Our campus is fully CCTV monitored, has gated entry with security personnel, and all our staff are background-verified and first-aid trained.
Yes, we have a comfortable, child-friendly uniform for regular days and a specific sports uniform for activity days. This helps foster a sense of belonging and equality.

faqs.q: How do you handle potty training?
faqs.a: We partner with parents during this transition. Our staff is patient and experienced in supporting children who are in the process of becoming toilet independent.

faqs.q: How do parents stay updated about daily activities?
faqs.a: We maintain regular communication through daily highlights, weekly observations, and personal interactions so families always feel deeply connected to their child's learning journey.

faqs.q: Do you focus only on academics?
faqs.a: No. Our holistic approach balances foundational literacy and numeracy with a strong emphasis on creative arts, emotional intelligence, social confidence, and independent critical thinking.
